name: Ken'zigla's Draught
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Ken'zigla prepares a bitter draught for the gravely wounded. A careful half dose restores enough strength to move, while more can make a patient bleed out.

sections.title: A Bitter Remedy
sections.body: Ken'zigla prepares the draught in the Stonetalon Mountains for those near death. Its strength must be measured with care: more than half a dose at once can make the patient bleed out as their circulation surges. Half a dose gives a wounded person enough vigor to move and flee danger. The rest must wait until the body steadies after a full night's rest.

sections.title: Mercy in the Barrens
sections.body: Horde warlocks carry the draught into a hostile razormane encampment north of Camp Taurajo, where Dogran is held. The operative was captured and tortured by quilboar. The medicine gives him enough vitality to hobble away, though his severe wounds have permanently cost him the use of his limbs.

faq.q: What is Ken'zigla's Draught used for?
aliases: why do i need kenziglas draught
faq.answer: Ken'zigla's Draught restores strength to people who are dying or grievously injured. Given carefully, it can help a wounded person move and escape captivity without fatal bleeding.
Ken'zigla, who lives in the Stonetalon Mountains, prepares the draught.

faq.q: Why must the draught only be taken half at a time?
faq.answer: The draught is exceptionally harsh on the body. Half a dose gives enough vigor to move without causing severe bleeding; the other half must wait until the patient has rested for a night to avoid fatal strain.
Dogran receives the draught. He is an operative held prisoner and badly injured in a quilboar camp north of Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why are warlocks sent to retrieve this medicine?
faq.answer: Horde warlocks seeking to bind a succubus are led to Dogran, who possesses an item of deep emotional resonance. Delivering the draught helps them reach him and secure what they need for the summoning ritual.

angles.text: As a warlock, you must find and deliver the draught during your trials to summon and bind a succubus. The journey across the Barrens tests your resourcefulness and tracking abilities.
With Camp Taurajo undermanned because of foraging patrols, the draught is the only lifeline for an operative captured behind enemy quilboar lines.
